passive.name: Deceit
passive.text: Increases the wearer's SPD by **18/21/24/27/30%**. After the wearer uses an attack, there is a **120%** base chance to inflict the "Bamboozle" state on every enemy target. While under the "Bamboozle" state, enemy targets have their DEF decreased by **16/18/20/22/24%** for **2** turn(s). If the wearer's SPD is higher than or equal to **170**, there is a **120%** base chance to inflict the "Theft" state on every enemy target. While under the "Theft" state, enemy targets have their DEF decreased by **8/9/10/11/12%** for **2** turn(s). When "Bamboozle" or "Theft" is repeatedly inflicted, only the most recently inflicted instance takes effect.

weapons.name: Resolution Shines As Pearls of Sweat

passive.name: Glance Back
passive.text: When the wearer hits an enemy and if the hit enemy is not already "Ensnared," then there is a **60/70/80/90/100%** base chance to "Ensnare" the hit enemy. "Ensnared" enemies' DEF decreases by **12/13/14/15/16%** for **1** turn(s).

passive.name: Quick on the Draw
passive.text: Increases the wearer's Effect Hit Rate by **20/25/30/35/40%**. When the wearer attacks DEF-reduced enemies, regenerates **4/5/6/7/8** Energy.

substatLine: Effect Hit Rate (Until 67%) = SPD (Until Breakpoint) > HP = DEF > Effect RES (30% with Broken Keel)
tracePriority: The Secret Strategy (A4) > Bash (A2) = Wipe Out (A6)

entries.name: Frost Shot
entries.text: Deals Ice DMG equal to **100%** of Pela's ATK to one designated enemy target.

entries.name: Frostbite
entries.text: Removes **1** buff(s) and deals Ice DMG equal to **210%** of Pela's ATK to one designated target enemy.

entries.name: Zone Suppression
entries.text:
Deals Ice DMG equal to **100%** of Pela's ATK to all enemies, with a **100%** base chance to inflict Exposed on all enemies.
When Exposed, enemies' DEF is reduced by **40%** for **2** turn(s).

entries.name: Data Collecting
entries.text: If the enemy is debuffed after Pela's attack, Pela will restore **10** additional Energy. This effect can only be triggered 1 time per attack.

entries.name: Preemptive Strike
entries.text: Immediately attacks the enemy. Upon entering battle, Pela deals Ice DMG equal to **80%** of her ATK to a random enemy, with a **100%** base chance of lowering the DEF of all enemies by **20%** for **2** turn(s).

entries.name: Bash
entries.text: Deals **20%** more DMG to debuffed enemy targets.

entries.name: The Secret Strategy
entries.text: When Pela is on the battlefield, all allies' Effect Hit Rate increases by **10%**.

entries.name: Wipe Out
entries.text: When using Skill to dispel buff(s), increases the DMG dealt by the next attack by **20%**.

entries.name: Victory Report
entries.text: When an enemy is defeated, Pela regenerates 5 Energy.

entries.name: Adamant Charge
entries.text: Using Skill to dispel buff(s) increases SPD by 10% for 2 turn(s).

entries.name: Suppressive Force
entries.text:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

entries.name: Full Analysis
entries.text: When using Skill, there is a 100% base chance to reduce the target enemy's Ice RES by 12% for 2 turn(s).

entries.name: Absolute Jeopardy
entries.text:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

entries.name: Feeble Pursuit
entries.text: After Pela attacks, if the enemy target is debuffed, deals Ice Additional DMG equal to 40% of Pela's ATK to the enemy.
